_comment_division: DIVISION CONFIG: Can be a single string OR a list of divisions/conferences to rotate through
_comment_examples: Single: 'NFC East' | Multiple: ['AFC East', 'NFC East', 'AFC North']
_comment_shortcut: SHORTCUT: Use 'AFC' or 'NFC' with display_type='division' to show ALL divisions in that conference
_comment_conference_mode: When display_type is 'conference', use conference names like ['AFC', 'NFC'] or division names will auto-extract conference
_comment_display_type: DISPLAY TYPE: 'division' shows division standings, 'conference' shows full conference standings
